premises.text: Voice talk has not been reinvented for mobile social the way photos and video have
premises.evidence_span: music, photos, and videos have all been reinvented for the mobile and social age. But what about talk, the voice, the podcast, the radio? You know, it's still behind

premises.text: Pundit talks are short conversational audio with engineering polish plus private disappearing voice messages
premises.evidence_span: Pundit will automatically reduce the background noise and engineer your voice to make you sound your best

premises.text: Growth via creator embedding/sharing and brand partnerships; web listening without installing the app
premises.evidence_span: Those fans could join the Pundit talks from anywhere on the web, whether or not they had the app

value.text: Turn the voice into fun, interactive social media
value.evidence_span: turn the voice into the newest wave of social media

notes: Primary value takes the 'newest wave' line as the valued outcome rather than a premise (§4.1(4)). Voice box kept inside P2 as part of one offering.
